title: Correct motion (NoRMCorre)
description: Runs NoRMCorre on the stack, when it is on the MATLAB path: rigid with gridSize 0 (or patches 1), piecewise rigid otherwise. Its options are passed to NoRMCorre under NoRMCorre's names (given in each option's description). Saves the aligned stack and the shifts of each frame (frames x 2, subpixel). Presets nonrigid and rigid are dev's NoRMCorre presets.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: Aligned stack
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

shiftsOutput.title: Shifts
shiftsOutput.description: Variable the shifts are saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

patches.title: Patches per side
patches.description: dev's numRows and numCols: when above 0, the frame is cut into this many patches down and across (a patch is round(height / patches) x round(width / patches) pixels); 1 is rigid. 0 uses gridSize

gridSize.title: Patch size (px)
gridSize.description: NoRMCorre's grid_size, the size of a patch (without its overlap); 0 for rigid correction. Not used when patches is above 0

upsampling.title: Upsampling factor
upsampling.description: NoRMCorre's us_fac: shifts are found to 1 / this of a pixel

maxDeviation.title: Largest patch deviation (px)
maxDeviation.description: NoRMCorre's max_dev: how far a patch's shift may be from the frame's

iterations.title: Passes
iterations.description: NoRMCorre's iter: passes over the recording

updateTemplate.title: Update the template
updateTemplate.description: NoRMCorre's upd_template: the template follows the aligned frames

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Of a stack with channels (height x width x channels x frames): the one to use, from 1

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a stack with planes (height x width x channels x planes x frames): the one to use, from 1
